xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:BriefDetailsOfCyberSecurityInc: 1(a). On January 3, 2025, Indus Towers perimeter suffered a breach due to a vulnerability in the firewall. This resulted in a malware being installed on one of the internal servers, enabling access to a filesystem and exfiltration of a few documents. 1(b). The perpetrator posted a claim on the Dark Web on a data leak site on January 14, 2025, at 12:38:04 stating that they were in possession of certain Indus Data. 1(c). Based on the screenshots shared by the threat actor on their data leak site, the exfiltrated data appears to include limited HR documents. 1(d). The threat actor did not provide any details with respect to the quantity of data allegedly exfiltrated from Indus Towers. 1(e). Indus Tower Cyber Security Team performed a thorough search on the Dark web and confirmed that there was no indication if any Protected Health Information (PHI), or Intellectual Property (IP) or Financial data that was compromised. 1(f). During this period Indus Cyber Security Team took all necessary steps to address the issue, review and strengthen cyber controls across Indus IT Infrastructure. 2. Indus Towers Team informed all regulatory and cyber authorities, and other stakeholders of the incident as is required to be done. 3. There was no system downtime, no impact to business operations, and no financial impact due to this incident. 4. No further activity has been observed in this regard by the threat actor and hence the incident has been concluded as a one off and stands closed.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: For FY 2009-10, The Hon'ble ITAT has pronounced an order on December 16, 2024 in favor of the Company on denial of depreciation on assets received under merger, disallowance of provision for expenses, amortization of ARO, provision for SLA Credit etc. This has a positive outcome for the Company and has resulted in a reduction of Rs. 35,573Mn (approx) in contingent liability. For FY 2010-11, the matter is pending before ITAT. For subsequent years upto FY 2016-17 (except FY 2014-15), the hearing has been concluded before Commissioner (Appeals) and the order is awaited. For FY 2018-19 to FY 2020-21, the assessments/reassessment proceedings have been completed, however the company has approached the HC against the orders. For FY 2021-22 the assessment has been completed, and appeal is pending before CIT(A).
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: For FY 2009-10, The Hon’ble ITAT has pronounced an order on December 16, 2024 in favor of the Company on denial of depreciation on assets received under merger, disallowance of provision for expenses, amortization of ARO, provision for SLA Credit etc. For FY 2010-11, the matter is pending before ITAT. For subsequent years upto FY 2016-17 (except FY 2014-15), the matter is pending before Commissioner (Appeals). For FY 2018-19 to FY 20-21, the assessment/reassessment proceedings have been completed, however the company has approached the HC against the orders. For FY 21-22 to FY 22-23 the assessment has been completed, and appeal is pending before CIT (Appeal). The expected financial implication is Rs. 3134 Mn (approx.)
